objective: Select the smallest authorized B with conservative identity-blind Holm-adjusted marginal rejection power at least 0.90 for every one of the six opaque primary hypotheses.

nuisanceEstimator.sourceUnits: eight opaque workload sources with two timing replicas per source across the same 24 structural batches
nuisanceEstimator.pseudoBlockConstruction: sample 16 opaque workload sources with replacement; sample one of two replicas for each selected lane; preserve each selected source's full 24-dimensional timing vector; apply the frozen ordinal-mod-worker deterministic assignment and reconstruct the worker makespan
nuisanceEstimator.batchCalibration: multiply each reconstructed makespan by its identity-blind observed batchWall/reconstructed-makespan calibration constant; constants disappear from centered nuisance covariance and are never serialized
nuisanceEstimator.processJitter: add independent zero-mean log jitter with sigma equal to max(0.03, pooled centered duplicate-log-difference divided by sqrt(2))
nuisanceEstimator.observedEffectsRemoved: center all six pseudo-block estimands before covariance; never serialize means or observed directions
nuisanceEstimator.smallSourceUncertainty: multiply variance by df/chi-square-lower-0.05(df), df=7, Wilson-Hilferty lower-quantile approximation
nuisanceEstimator.psdRule: symmetrize and raise eigenvalues below maxEigenvalue times 1e-10

powerSimulation.testStatistic: mean block estimand divided by sample standard error; asymptotic normal one-sided p-value as frozen for the block-robust primary estimator
powerSimulation.powerPerHypothesis: probability the given opaque primary is rejected by the complete Holm procedure
powerSimulation.uncertainty: two-sided 95 percent Wilson interval for each Monte Carlo rejection proportion
powerSimulation.passRule: minimum Wilson lower bound across the six opaque primaries is at least 0.90
powerSimulation.selectionRule: first passing B in ascending order

runtimeGate.actionAtOrAbove: stop before final implementation and schedule freeze and submit a simplified MQ proposal

outputSuppression: no condition identifiers from qualification rows
no fitted or observed effect means
no qualification direction rank weight or winner
failClosed: Any hash schema cardinality ordinal positivity covariance or finite-value violation terminates without selecting B.
